author: Donna McCahery
text: I just use an alcohol wipe, and it comes off easily.

author: Eileen Campbell
text: If it doesn't peel off easily, you can introduce a bit of oil around the edges to loosen it. There is a product made exclusively for that purpose, but that won't help you now

author: Gene Holcombe
text: Yank it off.  It’s not that hard to remove
